from pathlib import Path
import re
root=Path('school')
lessons=sorted((root/'src/content/lessons').glob('*.md'))
assert len(lessons)==7
for order,p in enumerate(lessons,1):
    s=p.read_text()
    fm=s.split('---',2)[1]
    for required in ['title:', 'slug:', 'description:', f'order: {order}', 'quiz: false', 'agentOnly: true', 'agentInstructions: |']:
        assert required in fm,(p,required)
    assert '{origin}/sources/material-1/' in fm,p
    assert 'a8a6fbec4e0e866d6d779b10889bb4f5567e70eb' in s,p
    assert not re.search(r'^import.*from.*react',s,re.M)
    for target in re.findall(r'\]\((/(?:sources|activities)/[^)]+)\)',s):
        assert (root/'public'/target.lstrip('/')).is_file(),(p,target)
    print(f'{p.name}: metadata and local links present ({len(s.splitlines())} lines)')
print('\nWritten files:')
for p in sorted(root.rglob('*')):
    if p.is_file(): print(p)
PY
